title: iFightDepression App Evaluation of use Evaluation of incidental usage data for further improvement of the intervention
summary: Depression is one of the most common illnesses. Around one in four women and one in eight men is affected by depression in the course of their lives. Often, the disease is not adequately treated, for example, due to long waiting times for appointments with specialists or psychological psychotherapists. One option to support the treatment are scientifically based digital programs that contain important information about depression and exercises for everyday life. The iFightDepression app is such a program and is used for people with mild to moderate depression. To further improve the content and structure of the program, this concurrent evaluation looks at anonymized usage data. For example, points in the app where use is frequently discontinued can be identified, but also those that particularly support long-term use or contribute to effectiveness.
conditions: Recurrent depressive disorder, current episode mild
Recurrent depressive disorder, current episode moderate

interventions.name: Evaluation of usage behavior within the iFightDepression app (self-management program)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Mild to moderate depressive episode in the context of a unipolar depressive episode (ICD-10 F32.0; F32.1) or recurrent unipolar depressive disorder (ICD-10: F33.0, F33.1) or dysthymia (as determined on the record by the prescribing provider)
- Outpatient status
- Respondent is able to communicate both orally and in writing, German-speaking
- Internet-enabled smartphone to download and use the intervention (iFightDepression app).
- Prescription of the iFightDepression app granted
- Digital consent given within the app
Exclusion criteria:
none
